boundary: Source hunt only. These findings name landed sources that can feed a typed all-of or exact-cardinality completeness relation, but they do not add candidates, do not relax rho admission, do not assert live proof, and do not allow a partial or unasserted schedule to exclude subsets.

operator_correction.decision: ACRIS legal rows remain the first adapter instance for the source-agnostic completeness mechanism.
operator_correction.measurement_limit: The retained E4 population cannot measure independent precision for ACRIS-fed completeness because its deed-truth BBL sets are derived from ACRIS legal rows joined on the matched mortgage document_id.
operator_correction.allowed_score_use: A completeness score on this population is a mechanism check only: collapse of feasible sets, false_merge preservation, abstention behavior, determinism, and replay.
operator_correction.forbidden_score_use: Do not cite resolved/exactly-correct movement from ACRIS-fed completeness on this population as independent precision.

scripts.evidence: ab joins accepted document id to EDGAR_DB.SOURCE.NYC_ACRIS_REAL_PROPERTY_LEGALS_EXT and constructs BBL from BOROUGH || BLOCK || LOT.
legal_documents aggregates ACRIS legal_edges into truth_bbls; accepted_subjects selects the single legal document per loan/truth plane.
header states the reach control measures whether bounded sections contain the accepted ACRIS truth BBLs.

loan_property_mart.license_terms: Derived mart row; source licensing is carried by the underlying SEC and source pins.

acris.license_terms: NYC Open Data public dataset; Socrata metadata did not provide a license code. Use under NYC Open Data Terms of Use with source attribution to Department of Finance (DOF).

candidate_sources.assertion: The mart bridge carries every latest property_key row attached to the loan_key and repeats LOAN_PROPERTY_COUNT on each row.
candidate_sources.safe_as_tax_lot_all_of_reason: The source asserts the loan's filed property-row fan-out, not the exact tax-lot set. A parcel all-of relation must abstain unless each property row is bridged to parcel ids by a total, unambiguous, source-pinned bridge.

candidate_sources.assertion: The landed ACRIS legal-row source is document by legal property row; for a bound mortgage or mortgage-consolidation instrument, the full set of legal rows is the instrument's asserted parcel set.
safe_as_tax_lot_all_of_preconditions: the ACRIS document is independently bound as the collateral-defining instrument for the loan or truth-scoring plane
the relation reads all legal rows for that document_id and release_dt from the complete staged source, not a sampled retained subset
partial-lot, air-rights, subterranean-rights, and easement flags are either explicitly admitted by the profile or cause abstention
candidate_sources.not_independent_of_truth_when_used_on_h7: The retained H7 truth plane is itself built from selected ACRIS legal rows. Using this source in E4 scoring is valid as a truth-plane completeness assertion; using it as production resolver evidence requires independent document binding to avoid truth leakage.

candidate_sources.assertion: Grouping by loan_key gives the complete filed property-row set at the mart bridge grain.
candidate_sources.safe_as_tax_lot_all_of_reason: Grouping by loan_key preserves property-row completeness, but one property row can represent zero, one, or many tax lots. A tax-lot exact-cardinality relation needs a separate total property-row-to-parcel mapping proof.

probe_cases.source_hunt_result: ACRIS legal rows assert the exact seven-lot instrument set. The SEC loan-property schedule also has seven property rows, but the property-row equality is not itself a tax-lot completeness proof.

ACRIS legal rows assert the exact three-lot instrument set. The SEC schedule is a two-property loan with one NYC property row and one Texas row, so it cannot be used as direct three-lot cardinality evidence.

ACRIS legal rows assert the exact four-lot NYC instrument set. The loan-property schedule is complete at eight filed property rows across NY, MI, AZ, and IL; the NYC subset count happens to match truth but that is not a loan-grain all-of assertion.

live_xref_probe.bridge_limit: The landed SEC/xref chain bridges schedule observations to canonical CMBS property_key values, not to tax-lot parcel ids. That is property-grain completeness evidence; tax-lot all-of requires a separate total row-to-parcel bridge.

sec_schedule_independent_thread.bridge_test_used: For the 18 retained subjects where bridge_loan source-record count equals truth-lot count, compare the retained rho.address.pad.membership union to the truth set as an evaluation check. The PAD bridge is independent of ACRIS; the truth set is used only to score whether the bridge was total and exact.
sec_schedule_independent_thread.interpretation: The independent SEC schedule is complete at property-row grain, but current retained artifacts only demonstrate a safe tax-lot all-of second instance for 6 of 70 subjects. The 18 count-equal subjects are an upper bound, not a ready denominator; reaching all 18 requires a row-level, source-pinned, total property-row-to-parcel bridge.

mechanism_handoff.positive_rule: Emit completeness only when a source asserts that the enumerated rows are the complete set at its declared grain and every member can be mapped into the selected entity grain without ambiguity.
mechanism_handoff.negative_safety_rule: If the source is a sample, primary-address field, partial extract, county subset, or has any unbridged row/member, the relation must abstain and exclude no subsets.
mechanism_handoff.expected_use_in_bd_2gvl: The generic mechanism can model ACRIS legal-row completeness for a bound document and loan-property schedule completeness at property-row grain. On the retained H7 population, ACRIS-fed scores must be labeled definitional-on-this-population rather than independent precision. The mechanism must not infer tax-lot cardinality from LOAN_PROPERTY_COUNT alone.
